findings.headline: Migrate this 3-argument createEffect call.
findings.why: Solid 1's signature is createEffect(fn, initialValue, options), but Solid 2's is createEffect(compute, effectFn, options): the second argument is the apply callback and options stay third.
findings.guidance: Move the initial value to a default parameter of the compute callback, pass the side effect as the second argument, and keep the options object third, dropping any option Solid 2 does not support: createEffect((prev = INITIAL_VALUE) => compute(prev), (value) => { ... }, options). If the second argument is already the apply callback, only the options need checking. Stop and ask when you cannot tell the role of each argument.
